text: Migration branch intent clarified with owner: archival refs preserve all development; they were not intended for blanket merges. Reviewed source is consolidated in PR20 and portable Mote/handoff in PR21. PR6 and PR22-29 are now drafts with independently simulated conflict paths and exact disposition in their descriptions; all nine heads are unchanged and readback verified. PR26 is wholly included in handoff. docs/verification/migration-pr-conflicts-20261005.md and .json record all 12 open PRs. Remaining archival feature work needs bounded current-base ports and its original acceptance gates. No historical source, branch or protection was changed.
